QualityRule.description: Service (CWE-1088): every outbound call carries an explicit timeout and a bounded retry policy with backoff — no infinite waits, no unbounded retry storms.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Find each HTTP/DB/queue client call: is a timeout set (not the library's infinite default)? Is retry bounded with backoff and jitter?
QualityRule.name: service-timeout-retry-explicit

QualityRule.description: Service: every exposed interface has a committed, versioned contract artifact (schema/IDL/OpenAPI) that consumers can ground against — the seam's single shared truth.
QualityRule.detection_logic: For each endpoint/event/queue the service exposes: where is the contract file, is it in the repo, and does the implementation actually match it?
QualityRule.name: service-contract-artifact

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Security (CWE-284/732): expose the minimum — no debug/admin paths reachable in production flows, no overly-permissive file modes or defaults.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Enumerate what the intent exposes (endpoints, files written, flags) and check each against who actually needs it.
QualityRule.name: iso5055-sec-least-surface

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Security (CWE-89/78/79): untrusted data is never concatenated into SQL/shell/HTML/query strings — parameterize, escape at the boundary, or reject.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Trace untrusted inputs to every interpreter sink (exec/system calls, query strings, format/eval, HTML output) and check the escaping/parameterization at each.
QualityRule.name: iso5055-sec-no-injection

QualityRule.description: Service (CWE-306/862): every externally reachable endpoint authenticates and authorizes before side effects — including 'internal' endpoints reachable from outside the trust zone.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Enumerate reachable routes; for each, find the auth check and confirm it runs before any write or privileged read.
QualityRule.name: service-auth-at-boundary

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Security (CWE-798): no credentials, tokens, or keys in source or config committed to the repo; secrets come from the environment or a secret store.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Scan the intent's files for key-like literals, connection strings with passwords, and tokens; check how the code obtains credentials.
QualityRule.name: iso5055-sec-no-hardcoded-secrets

QualityRule.description: Service: handlers for retriable inputs — webhooks, queue messages, payments — are idempotent; replaying the same message yields no duplicate effect.
QualityRule.detection_logic: For each handler: what happens on exact redelivery? Look for inserts without dedup keys, counters without idempotency tokens, side effects before the dedup check.
QualityRule.name: service-idempotent-handlers

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Reliability (CWE-772/404): every acquired resource (file, lock, connection, handle) is released on ALL paths, including error paths.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Look for acquisitions without RAII/defer/finally protection, locks held across I/O or awaits, and early returns that skip cleanup.
QualityRule.name: iso5055-rel-resource-release

QualityRule.description: trust norm: no verdict-bearing edge may default to passing; compliance/proof states start uninspected and are earned by an inspecting agent
QualityRule.name: green-is-earned

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Performance Efficiency (CWE-834/1050): no unbounded loops/recursion over external-sized data; iteration and queries are bounded, paginated, or capped.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Look for loops over unbounded collections nested in loops (N+1 patterns), recursion without a depth guard, and full scans where a limit exists.
QualityRule.name: iso5055-perf-bounded-work

QualityRule.description: Service (sagas): multi-step workflows define compensation or abort for partial failure — no half-completed state without a recovery path an operator or the code can take.
QualityRule.detection_logic: For each workflow spanning >1 service or transaction: enumerate the failure point after each step and name the compensating action. A missing one is the violation.
QualityRule.name: service-compensation-defined

QualityRule.description: Service: contract changes are additive or versioned — removing/renaming fields or changing semantics requires a version consumers can pin; old versions get a deprecation path.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Diff the contract's history (or its change discipline): were fields ever removed/renamed in place? Is there a versioning convention at all?
QualityRule.name: service-compatible-evolution

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Reliability (CWE-20): external input (CLI args, file content, env vars, network data) is validated before use; invalid input yields a typed error, never corruption or a crash.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Trace each external input to its first use: is there a validation/parse step with an error path before the value reaches logic or storage?
QualityRule.name: iso5055-rel-boundary-validation

QualityRule.description: Service: failures are logged/metric'd with enough context (ids, cause, upstream) to diagnose without reproducing.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Pick the main failure paths: what exactly lands in logs/metrics? Catch-and-ignore blocks and bare 500s with no context are violations.
QualityRule.name: service-observable-failures

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Maintainability (CWE-561/1041): no unreachable or unused code; no copy-pasted logic where one definition should exist.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Look for unused functions/exports, commented-out blocks kept 'just in case', and near-identical logic in sibling files.
QualityRule.name: iso5055-main-no-dead-or-duplicate-code

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Maintainability (CWE-1080/1120): each unit (file, function, intent) owns one coherent responsibility; oversized or multi-concern units are split.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Check unit sizes and concern count; cross-check `loom smells` (tangled_file / scattered_intent) for the same intent.
QualityRule.name: iso5055-main-single-responsibility

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Reliability (CWE-252/248/391): every fallible operation's failure path is handled or explicitly propagated — no silently ignored return value, no exception/panic escaping a boundary uncaught.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Inspect the intent's error paths: ignored Results/return codes, unwrap/expect on external input, bare catch-alls, missing error branches at I/O, parse, lock, and network boundaries.
QualityRule.name: iso5055-rel-no-unchecked-failure

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 Performance Efficiency (CWE-1042/1046): no repeated identical I/O, queries, or allocation in hot paths — cache or hoist invariant work out of loops.
QualityRule.detection_logic: Find work inside loops that is invariant across iterations (reads, compiles, allocations) and repeated identical calls that could be batched.
QualityRule.name: iso5055-perf-no-redundant-work

QualityRule.description: ISO 5055 reliability: no GQL may match or filter a relationship by its own property (grafeo 0.5.x returns nondeterministic results); edges are keyed by endpoint nodes or scanned and filtered in Rust
QualityRule.name: endpoint-matched-edges

QualityRule.description: Service: a dependency outage degrades the service (fallback, partial answer, fast error) — it never cascades into hangs or crash loops.
QualityRule.detection_logic: For each hard dependency: trace what happens when it's down. Look for unguarded startup dependencies and synchronous calls on the hot path with no circuit/fallback.
QualityRule.name: service-graceful-degradation
